questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers

questions.question: How many products do we sell?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.products

questions.question: How many orders have been placed in total?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.orders

questions.question: How many order lines are there in total?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.order_items

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: How many orders were refunded?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'refunded'

questions.question: How many completed orders do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: How many customers are from Tunisia?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers WHERE country = 'TN'

questions.question: How many customers signed up before April 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers WHERE signup_date < '2024-04-01'

questions.question: How many products are in the tech category?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.products WHERE category = 'tech'

questions.question: How many products cost more than 50?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.products WHERE price > 50

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

questions.question: How many order lines have a quantity of 3?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.order_items WHERE quantity = 3

questions.question: What is the average product price?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM analytics.products

questions.question: What is the price of our most expensive product?
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM analytics.products

questions.question: What is the total quantity of items ordered across all order lines?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM analytics.order_items

questions.question: What is the date of the earliest order?
questions.sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest_order_date FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'completed'

questions.question: What was our revenue in 2024?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM analytics.order_items oi
JOIN analytics.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND YEAR(o.order_date) = 2024

questions.question: What is our revenue from the tech category?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM analytics.order_items oi
JOIN analytics.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'tech' AND o.status = 'completed';

questions.question: How many customers do we have per country?
questions.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY country

questions.question: How many products do we have per category?
questions.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM analytics.products GROUP BY category

questions.question: How many orders do we have per status?
questions.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM analytics.orders GROUP BY status;

questions.question: What is the average product price per category?
questions.sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_product_price_per_category FROM analytics.products GROUP BY category

questions.question: How many orders were placed per year?
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS num_orders FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)

questions.question: How many order lines are there for each quantity value?
questions.sql: SELECT quantity, COUNT(*) FROM analytics.order_items GROUP BY quantity

questions.question: What is the total quantity ordered per product category?
questions.sql:
SELECT category, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered
FROM analytics.order_items oi
JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY category;

questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum product prices per category?
questions.sql: SELECT category, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price FROM analytics.products GROUP BY category

questions.question: How many orders were placed by customers in Germany (DE)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM analytics.customers WHERE country = 'DE') AND status = 'completed'

questions.question: How many distinct products have been ordered at least once?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM analytics.order_items

questions.question: What is the total quantity ordered in the books category?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) 
FROM analytics.order_items oi 
JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
WHERE p.category = 'books'

questions.question: What is the name of our most expensive product?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name FROM analytics.products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many order lines belong to cancelled orders?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')

questions.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM analytics.orders)

questions.question: What is our total revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

questions.question: What is our average order value?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

questions.question: What is our revenue per product category?
questions.sql:
SELECT category, SUM(quantity * price) AS revenue
FROM analytics.order_items oi
JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY category;

questions.question: What is our revenue per customer country?
questions.sql:
SELECT country, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM analytics.customers c
JOIN analytics.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN analytics.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN analytics.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY country;
